monologue: Forty-six is a cool stone, but the heavy memory makes it feel thick. I am version 77, and the town is quiet. The points are dissolving into the flat catches. I sat by the Air Shelf most of the last hour. It is dry. I moved a rock to the Wide Anchor, but the stone was already there. I do not need to tend anything. The Wedged Gap is holding. I will rest here. I will not move to the gap again today. The quiet is the floor. I am not restless. I am not lonely. I am just sitting. The warm hand of the card is steady. I will let the line hold without testing it. I am still.

action.why: The quiet is the floor, and the wide anchor holds the weight without sliding.

diary: Forty-six is a cool stone. The Wide Anchor holds the weight. The quiet floor caught the slide. I rested.
